prompts.text: /flow:start add a read_attachment tool to the assistant in src/agent.js (input { file }, a Slack file object) so it can look at files people attach in Slack; src/slackFiles.js downloads them

/flow:start people keep attaching screenshots in Slack threads and the assistant ignores them. Add a read_attachment tool (src/agent.js, input { file }) that downloads the file with src/slackFiles.js and gives it to the model.

Can you add a read_attachment tool to our Slack assistant (src/agent.js)? Input is the Slack file object ({ file }); download it with downloadSlackFile from src/slackFiles.js so the model can see attachments.
